BTMTM.description: Boiling transition wall momentum transfer model selected from the upstream enum

SPHTM.description: Single-phase wall heat transfer model selected from the upstream enum

DITTUSBOELTERCOEF.description: Coefficients for the upstream generalized Dittus-Boelter option (DITTUSBOELTERGEN), which is currently unsupported. The supported DITTUSBOELTER model uses its fixed upstream constants 0.023, 0.8 and 0.4; changing this vector does not alter that model.

TPHTM.description: Two-phase wall heat transfer model selected from the upstream enum

BTHTM.description: Boiling transition wall heat transfer model selected from the upstream enum

VOID.description: Void fraction model selected from the upstream enum

THERMALNONEQ.description: Thermal non-equilibrium model selected from the upstream enum

THERMALRELAX.description: Thermal non-equilibrium time relaxation model selected from the upstream enum

RELAXX.description: Interfacial phase change relaxation time thermodynamic quality

RELAXCONDFO.description: Interfacial condensation Fourier number array  for THERMALRELAX FOURIERX model The upstream implementation uses the first len(RELAXX) entries; any remaining entries are retained but unused by this interpolation.

RELAXEVAPFO.description: Interfacial evaporation  Fourier number array  for THERMALRELAX FOURIERX model The upstream implementation uses the first len(RELAXX) entries; any remaining entries are retained but unused by this interpolation.

RELAXCONDT.description: Interfacial condensation relaxation time array  for THERMALRELAX TIMEX model The upstream implementation uses the first len(RELAXX) entries; any remaining entries are retained but unused by this interpolation.

RELAXEVAPT.description: Interfacial evaporation  relaxation time array  for THERMALRELAX TIMEX model The upstream implementation uses the first len(RELAXX) entries; any remaining entries are retained but unused by this interpolation.

RELAXCONDCOEF.description: Condensation relaxation coefficients [length scale, void exponent, void/quality bias, nonequilibrium-quality exponent]. Used by VOID/HOMOGENEOUS thermal relaxation closures; not every component is used by every closure.

RELAXEVAPCOEF.description: Evaporation relaxation coefficients [length scale, void exponent, void bias, nonequilibrium-quality exponent]. Used by VOID/HOMOGENEOUS thermal relaxation closures; not every component is used by every closure.

RELAXCONDFOCOEF.description: Condensation Fourier closure coefficients [prefactor, Reynolds-number scale, Reynolds-number exponent, reduced-pressure exponent].

RELAXEVAPFOCOEF.description: Evaporation Fourier closure coefficients [prefactor, Reynolds-number scale, Reynolds-number exponent, reduced-pressure exponent, diameter scale, diameter exponent].

KTRELAX.description: Local thermal-relaxation time override. Use the quoted JSON string "NaN" for the upstream automatic sentinel; positive values override the closure. One value or one per KLOC.

NEARWALLEQOAF.description: Near-wall equilibrium at onset of annular two-phase flow

NEARWALLH.description: Near-wall equilibrium enthalpy model selected from the upstream enum

NEARWALLRELAX.description: Near-wall energy transfer time relaxation model selected from the upstream enum

NEARWALLRELAXX.description: Near-wall exchange relaxation time thermodynamic quality

NEARWALLRELAXT.description: Near-wall energy transfer relaxation time array The upstream implementation uses the first len(NEARWALLRELAXX) entries.

NEARWALLRELAXCOEF.description: Near-wall VOID relaxation coefficients [length scale, void exponent, void bias].

INTLENGTH.description: Interfacial length scale model selected from the upstream enum

INTAREA.description: Interfacial area model selected from the upstream enum

BASEEQTHICK.description: Equilibrium base film thickness model selected from the upstream enum

RELAXTB.description: Base film / wave mass exchange relaxation time

WAVEMIXCOEF.description: Base film / wave turbulent mixing coefficient; retained as an upstream column-vector input. For one wall provide one value.

WAVEFREQUENCY.description: Wave number density model selected from the upstream enum

EQSTROUHAL.description: Equilibrium wave Strouhal number model selected from the upstream enum

MOMENTBASE.description: Base film momentum conservation model selected from the upstream enum

ANGLE.description: Inclination from vertical, in degrees. Geometry.m and the governing cosine use degrees; the bundled geom.inp comment incorrectly says rad.

TIME.description: Time assigned to this steady boundary record. The GUI runs one steady state; transient schedules are outside this first GUI scope.

WMESH.description: Lengths of successive axial power segments; their sum must match geometry LENGTH within the upstream relative tolerance 0.001.

WPOWER.description: Relative power matrix: rows are axial segments, columns are channel walls. The solver normalizes this distribution to POWER using wall perimeter and its axial grid. Original flat .inp vectors use MATLAB column-major ordering.
